crossRefs.note: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given…
They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and…
The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be…
For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure…
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were…

translations.web: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.
translations.bsb: If the guilty man deserves to be beaten, the judge shall have him lie down and be flogged in his presence with the number of lashes his crime warrants.
translations.kjv: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.
translations.asv: and it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.
